name: Scope Then Ship
description: Scope gate, pre-flight, implement, QA in browser, retro — no code before scope approval.
kickoff:
Start the "Scope Then Ship" loop.
Goal: approved scope shipped with QA evidence
Max iterations: 6
Exit when: scope items done and QA ship verdict is SHIP or CONDITIONAL
Orientation: read the linked ticket to confirm scope boundaries before ceo-scope-review.
Step 1: Run ceo-scope-review before any implementation.

loop_contract.name: Scope Then Ship
loop_contract.goal: approved scope shipped with QA evidence
loop_contract.exit_when: scope complete and QA ship verdict SHIP or CONDITIONAL
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
loop_contract.step_1: Run ceo-scope-review on the ticket. Present HOLD / REDUCE / EXPAND / SELECTIVE EXPANSION. Produce a revised scope doc before any implementation.

steps.name: Scope review gate
steps.instruction: Run ceo-scope-review on the ticket. Present HOLD / REDUCE / EXPAND / SELECTIVE EXPANSION. Produce a revised scope doc before any implementation.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Scope mode selected and revised scope document produced.

steps.name: Pre-flight review
steps.instruction: Run pre-flight-review on the approved scope. Surface P0 blockers. Auto-fix mechanical issues only.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
steps.validation_prompt: Pre-flight verdict is READY or CONDITIONAL with no open P0.

steps.name: Implement
steps.instruction: Execute the approved scope with executing-plans and tdd-workflow. One iteration slice if the scope is large.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
- Detect lint and test commands from the repo (package.json, Makefile, pyproject.toml, etc.)
- Do not assume npm — use whatever this project actually uses
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Approved scope slice implemented with passing local checks.

steps.name: QA pass
steps.instruction: Run qa-tester STANDARD on critical paths. Use webapp-testing for UI flows. Health score and ship verdict required.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: QA health score produced; ship verdict SHIP or CONDITIONAL; P0/P1 addressed.

steps.name: Evaluate exit
steps.instruction: All scope items for this iteration complete and QA passed. Otherwise loop to implement.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof

steps.name: Session retro
steps.instruction: Run session-retro. Log top learnings to learnings-keeper.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
